name: Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian
label: Quest
description: Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This final task will be the most difficult of all, friend. You have faced and defeated both an Old God and the Lich King's General, but now you must face the hand of Sargeras.

Take the staff to Stratholme. It is there that you will find a piece of consecrated earth: ground where the greatest knights of Lordaeron were murdered. Place the befouled staff upon the holy ground and prepare for an entity of immense power to break from within... Defeat the demonic being that controls the staff and return to me.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The magnitude of this accomplishment must not be understated, friend. You have done what most would have thought to be impossible. Alas, it was fated. The staff has made its choice...
